verdicts.reason: The current YAML bears this out: F-2-13, F-2-81, F-2-T1 and F-2-16 have no in-edges, so F-5-19, F-5-22, F-5-T1, F-5-28 and F-5-29 can only be reached by a reader who starts on those statuses. The manual covers the three family codes: F-2-13 is changed in Korea together with F-2-12, F-2-81 together with F-2-8 (both lists cover the 'spouse and unmarried children'), and F-2-T1 has a single list for 'visa issuance, change of status and extension'. Parts of the proposed fix are wrong. NONE→F-2-13/F-2-81 abroad has no source: the investors themselves reach F-2-8/F-2-12 only by changing status from B-1/B-2/C-3, and visadocs has no abroad list for these codes. F-1→investor-family is unsourced, and an in-edge for F-2-16 would invent a route, because 카목 is a discretionary Ministry of Justice recognition with no application route; F-2-16 should stay start-only. Network was unavailable this round, so the quotes come from the 2026 manual as transcribed in data/visadocs.yaml and from the decree text quoted in earlier rounds.

verdicts.reason: Right about the repo: no F-2-* node lists F-2-R or F-2-7S, F-2-71 has no F-3 move, and visadocs' within table records these as change moves. F-2-R's change rule is open to lawful residents (the excluded statuses are D-3, D-4, E-6-2, E-8, E-9, E-10, G-1, H-1), so F-2 holders may legally switch. As a map step, though, the blanket fix is wrong. F-2-R's only exit here is F-5-1, which the repo itself calls 'No dedicated route: F-2 years count toward F-5-1'. Adding it to F-2-99, F-2-3, F-2-5, F-2-7, F-2-8, F-2-12 and F-2-T would add a lateral option that is always open (unknown facts never block) and leads nowhere faster than those statuses' own PR routes, which worsens the 'wrong next options' complaint. F-2-R→F-2-7S adds nothing over the existing D-2-3/D-2-4→F-2-7S edges. Only the F-2-71 moves have a real use: a fallback when the sponsor's income drops, and a status of one's own.

verdicts.reason: In the repo, E-7-4 has in-edges only from E-9, E-10 and H-2. The quoted S740 passage (② 뿌리산업 인력 양성대학 졸업자, change of status, 300 a year) is plausible, but I could not re-read it: the network was down, and the e7.txt it cites is not in this environment. More importantly, nothing shows that this track issues the E-7-4 sub-code that this repo models. The E-7-4 node's how, its `needs: {stay: {years: 4, in: [E-9, E-10, H-2]}}`, and its only document list ('E-9/E-10/H-2 worker converting to E-7-4') all describe the points conversion. The proposed gate `koreanEdu: 2` is supplied automatically by D-2-1/D-2-2's gives, so the move would be open to every student, while it is really limited to graduates of designated 뿌리 training colleges under a 300-place quota. Recommend no change until the S740 entry is read and its sub-code established.
